theme.styleGuide:
Lime Venture is a builtin QoderWork AI Slides visual reference. Match its dark, high-energy, metrics-forward pitch-deck scheme and its young, hungry, bold, growth-story tone while using the bundled Alibaba PuHuiTi 3.0 font stack for generated slides.
Reference typography cues: display/heading: Archivo (wide, heavy weights); body: Inter; mono: JetBrains Mono; serif_cn: Noto Serif SC; sans_cn: Noto Sans SC. Treat these font names as visual cues, not external font dependencies.
Color language: near-black ink canvas (#0D110E) with warm white type (#F2F5F0) and a single electric lime accent (#A3E635, brightened to #BEF264 for the hottest emphasis). Lime is used with restraint — reserved for the biggest numbers, upward arrows, key metrics, emphasis words, hairline rules, and small graphic marks. Everything structural stays white-on-black.
Best for: Seed/Series-A fundraising decks for consumer, creator-economy, and growth-stage startups; demo day presentations; growth reviews that lead with momentum and metrics. The system is engineered to make big numbers, hockey-stick curves, and bold single-claim statements land hard.
Reference notes: A momentum-forward demo-day deck system — every slide is the same ink-black field (#0D110E) with warm white type floating on it, and a single electric lime accent (#A3E635 / #BEF264) doing all the emotional work. Archivo in its widest, heaviest weights carries the display headlines and the oversized stat numbers — the deck shouts through weight and width, not through color. Inter handles body copy in a clean supporting role; JetBrains Mono provides the kicker/label/page-chrome voice, appearing as small uppercase tracked labels and a page counter on every slide. The lime is deliberately rationed: it colors the hero numbers, the rising-arrow glyphs, the em-emphasis inside white headlines, the 40px accent rules, and the winning column in comparisons — and nothing else. Dividers on the black field are low-opacity white hairlines. The mood is a founder on stage at demo day: confident, fast, numbers-first, allergic to anything decorative. One field, warm white type, one loud lime accent used exactly where the growth story peaks.

decorativePatterns.description:
Ink-black canvas charged with lime-green accents and warm white type. Young, hungry, growth-story energy for new-generation founders.
near-black ink field (#0D110E) with warm white type (#F2F5F0) on every slide, and a single electric lime accent (#A3E635 brightened to #BEF264) rationed to hero numbers, upward arrows, key metrics, emphasis words, hairline rules and small graphic marks; one coherent dark palette across every slide, no inverted theme.
wide heavy Archivo as the display and stat face, clean Inter body, and JetBrains Mono for kickers/labels/page chrome; bilingual EN/CN support via Noto Serif SC / Noto Sans SC visual cues.
Lime Venture is a **momentum-forward demo-day** presentation system. The premise is loud and disciplined at once: every slide is the same ink-black field (`{colors.background}` — #0D110E) with warm white type (`{colors.text}` — #F2F5F0), and one electric lime accent (`{colors.primary}` — #A3E635, brightened to `{colors.accent}` — #BEF264 for the hottest emphasis) carries all the energy. There is no light theme and no inversion.
The color philosophy is **one field, one loud accent, held back until it counts**. The field is #0D110E; a slightly lifted surface (`{colors.surface}` — #161C17) and a deep green-black (`{colors.secondary}` — #26302A) build panels and the losing side of comparisons. Type is #F2F5F0 for primary and #9BA39A (`{colors.textSecondary}`) for secondary. Lime appears only on: oversized stat numbers, the up-arrow growth glyphs, `<em>` emphasis inside white headlines, the winning comparison column, kickers, and the 40px accent rule. It never fills large areas.
Depth is **flat, wide, and heavy**. No drop shadows, no gradients, minimal rounding. Borders are 1px white hairlines at ~10-14% opacity — faint structural marks on the black. Big Archivo weight and width, not color, create the shout. The mood is a founder on stage at demo day: fast, confident, numbers-first.
**Key Characteristics:** - Single ink-black field — `{colors.background}` (#0D110E) — on every slide, warm white type, one rationed lime accent where the growth story peaks. No light theme, no inversion.
